```{python}
#| label: fig-litho-scanner
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "The optical column of a projection lithography scanner: light from the source passes through the illuminator, which shapes its angular distribution, onto the reticle, and the projection optics image a demagnified copy of the reticle field into the photoresist. The scanner exposes the wafer field by field. Resolution and depth of focus both follow from the wavelength and the numerical aperture of the optics."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, Polygon, Ellipse, FancyBboxPatch

# The drawing uses a fixed layout grid with y pointing downwards; the axes
# fill the figure, so one drawing unit maps to a constant number of points
# and the font sizes below are the ones of the layout grid.
X0, X1 = 30.0, 900.0
Y0, Y1 = 116.0, 610.0
FIGW = 7.5

C = {
    'ink': '#1f2933',      # headings
    'text': '#5b6672',     # annotations
    'faint': '#7a828c',    # secondary notes
    'rule': '#d6dbe1',     # panel border
    'panel': '#f4f6f8',    # panel fill
    'tick': '#b9bfc7',     # dimension lines
    'dark': '#33383f',     # source housing, mask absorber
    'beam': '#7fb3e0',     # light path
    'lens': '#c9e1f0',     # lens elements
    'lens_e': '#6e9dbe',
    'glass': '#dce9f2',    # reticle blank
    'glass_e': '#a9c4d6',
    'resist': '#e7b24c',   # unexposed resist
    'resist_e': '#c08f2e',
    'exposed': '#f2dfa8',  # exposed resist
    'sub': '#c2c7ce',      # wafer
    'sub_e': '#9aa1aa',
}

ABSORB = [(165, 199), (237, 259), (305, 345)]   # reticle absorber runs


def fs(size):
    """Font size (in points) of a label given in layout units."""
    return size * FIGW * 72.0 / (X1 - X0)


def box(x, y, w, h, fc, ec=None, lw=1.0, alpha=1.0, z=2):
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x, y), w, h, fc=fc, ec=ec or 'none',
                           lw=lw if ec else 0, alpha=alpha, zorder=z))


def label(x, y, s, size=13, color='text', ha='left', weight='normal'):
    ax.text(x, y, s, fontsize=fs(size), color=C[color], ha=ha,
            va='baseline', fontweight=weight, zorder=6)


def beam(pts):
    """Cone of light between two apertures, given as corner points."""
    ax.add_patch(Polygon(pts, closed=True, fc=C['beam'], ec='none',
                         alpha=0.26, zorder=1))


def dim(x0, x1, y, s=4):
    """Dimension line with end ticks."""
    ax.plot([x0, x1], [y, y], color=C['tick'], lw=0.8, zorder=3)
    for x in (x0, x1):
        ax.plot([x, x], [y - s, y + s], color=C['tick'], lw=0.8, zorder=3)


fig = plt.figure(figsize=(FIGW, FIGW * (Y1 - Y0) / (X1 - X0)))
ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1])
ax.set_xlim(X0, X1)
ax.set_ylim(Y1, Y0)          # y grows downwards, as in the layout grid
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')

# light source
box(205, 126, 120, 38, C['dark'], z=3)
ax.text(265, 151, 'Source', fontsize=fs(14), color='white', ha='center',
        va='baseline', fontweight='bold', zorder=6)
label(195, 142, r'$\lambda = 193$ nm (ArF)', ha='right')
label(195, 159, 'or 13.5 nm (EUV)', ha='right')

# illuminator: shapes the angular spectrum of the light
beam([(205, 164), (325, 164), (357, 192), (173, 192)])
box(172, 192, 186, 26, C['lens'], C['lens_e'], lw=1.0)
ax.text(265, 210, 'Illuminator', fontsize=fs(13), color='#2e4a5e',
        ha='center', va='baseline', zorder=6)
label(162, 200, r'shapes $\sigma$,', ha='right')
label(162, 217, 'dipole / quasar', ha='right')
box(175, 218, 180, 32, C['beam'], alpha=0.26, z=1)
dim(145, 385, 238)

# reticle: glass blank with a patterned absorber
box(145, 250, 240, 11, C['glass'], C['glass_e'], lw=0.8)
for x0, x1 in ABSORB:
    box(x0, 261, x1 - x0, 10, C['dark'], z=3)
label(135, 256, 'Reticle', ha='right')
label(135, 273, r'features 4$\times$ larger', ha='right')

# projection optics: two lens groups demagnifying the reticle image
beam([(145, 271), (385, 271), (347, 310), (183, 310)])
ax.add_patch(Ellipse((265, 322), 188, 34, fc=C['lens'], ec=C['lens_e'],
                     lw=1.0, zorder=2))
beam([(190, 336), (340, 336), (328, 366), (202, 366)])
ax.add_patch(Ellipse((265, 380), 156, 30, fc=C['lens'], ec=C['lens_e'],
                     lw=1.0, zorder=2))
label(163, 318, 'Projection optics', ha='right')
label(163, 335, r'4$\times$ reduction', ha='right')
label(163, 352, 'NA 1.35 immersion', ha='right')
label(163, 369, 'NA 0.33 / 0.55 EUV', ha='right')

# wafer plane
beam([(202, 394), (328, 394), (297, 500), (233, 500)])
box(145, 500, 240, 18, C['resist'], C['resist_e'], lw=0.8)
box(233, 500, 64, 18, C['exposed'], C['resist_e'], lw=0.8, z=3)
box(145, 518, 240, 28, C['sub'], C['sub_e'], lw=0.8)
label(135, 513, 'Photoresist', ha='right')
label(135, 537, 'Wafer', ha='right')
label(395, 513, 'exposed area')
dim(233, 297, 560)
label(265, 580, r'image demagnified 4$\times$', size=12.5, color='faint',
      ha='center')
label(265, 597, 'scanner steps this field across the wafer', size=12.5,
      color='faint', ha='center')

# what sets the limit
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((430, 296), 460, 134, boxstyle='round,pad=0,'
                            'rounding_size=6', fc=C['panel'], ec=C['rule'],
                            lw=0.8, zorder=1))
label(450, 321, 'What sets the limit', size=15, color='ink', weight='bold')
label(450, 351, r'$R = k_1 \cdot \lambda\,/\,\mathrm{NA}$', size=17,
      color='ink')
label(640, 351, r'$\mathrm{DOF} = k_2 \cdot \lambda\,/\,\mathrm{NA}^2$',
      size=17, color='ink')
label(450, 380, r'Shorter $\lambda$ and larger NA both sharpen resolution, '
      'but depth of')
label(450, 398, 'focus collapses with NA$^2$, which is why resists are thin '
      'and focus')
label(450, 416, r'control is tight. A single exposure bottoms out near '
      r'$k_1 = 0.25$.')

plt.show()
```
